reason: The plugin is primarily an orchestration utility: README and metadata describe a DeepSeek Harness plugin that creates durable multi-agent teams, assigns and claims tasks, routes members to configured model providers, records task and usage state, and exposes management controls through `teams_meta_*` tools plus a web sidebar view, while storing state in a workspace directory.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 `teams_meta_*` 工具创建并管理多成员智能体团队、分配并追踪任务，并在侧边栏展示团队与路由状态。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that creates and manages multi-agent teams via `teams_meta_*` tools, delegates and tracks tasks, and shows team and routing state in a read-only sidebar view.

capabilities: Team and task orchestration via DSH tools (`teams_meta_*`)
Persistent workspace state storage for teams, tasks, routes, mailbox logs, and usage ledger
Per-member model/provider routing and route switching behavior
Read-only team-status panel exposed in DSH web sidebar
